documents.changeNoteHint: Stored on the version this edit snapshots, so it describes the change rather than the document.
documents.noRelated: Nothing related yet — tag this document to connect it to others.
documents.noVersionsYet: No versions yet — the first edit after publishing creates one.
documents.versionsAfterPublish: Versions start once this document is published.
documents.reasonPlaceholder: What needs to change before this can be published?
documents.reasonHint: Required — a rejection with no note leaves the author nothing to act on.

access.title: Who can reach this document
access.openHint: This document follows the ordinary permissions. Adding the first person below restricts it to whoever is named.
access.restrictedHint: This document is restricted. Only the people and roles listed below can reach it — removing every entry opens it back up.
access.none: No grants — the document is open.

documents.pin: Pin to the top of this space

protection.title: Protection level
protection.normalExplain: The document reads as itself, with your name watermarked over it in the browser and injected into any PDF you export. The overlay is a deterrent — someone determined can remove it in dev tools.
protection.strictExplain: The text never leaves the server. Every page is rendered as an image with the watermark in the pixels, so there is nothing to select and nothing to strip. No text search inside the page, and no screen reader.
protection.renderFailed: This document could not be rendered.
protection.pagesFooter: {count} watermarked page(s), rendered on the server

share.title: Share by link
share.hint: A link opens this one document, for as long as it lasts, without an account. It carries the name of whoever created it.
share.onceOnly: Copy this now — it is shown once and cannot be looked up again.

accessLog.title: Access log
accessLog.hint: Every view, download, print and export of this document. Append-only — nothing here can be edited or removed.

shared.unavailableBody: It may have expired, been revoked, or the document may no longer be published. Ask whoever shared it for a new one.
